Went up at 8am yesterday and was given an appointment at 9.15. Finally ditched that ridiculous ‘call back’ step 👏\n\nWho wants to play phone roulette at 8am when they are feeling unwell? Even if you do persevere and finally get through, you are triaged by a receptionist who says you will be called back ‘at some point during the day.’ Even worse if it’s the emergency service, you’re told ‘the doctor will only call once, so make sure you are by your phone.’  So you stay glued to your phone and when you finally do get a call back, you have to repeat the story you told the receptionist hours earlier. The clinician who calls then decides whether your issue is worthy of being seen in person. A ridiculous set-up, which is frankly, a complete waste of time and only acts to exacerbate patient stress levels. If you get through and an appointment is available, you should get one. Staff should not be able to pick and choose who they see. I believe continuity of care is essential. Sadly, it appears those days are gone. The doctors at Barclay move between its surgeries, which makes building any kind of rapport/trust with a particular clinician, impossible. This can be very frustrating when you are having to repeat your ‘story’ over and over again. That said, the clinicians I have encountered, I believe, have done their best. A particular shout-out to Helen (ANP) and Lauren on reception who have taken the time to listen and respond promptly. GPs like my previous Doctor, John Parris, who would go above and beyond for his patients (and has now sadly passed away) unfortunately seem to be a thing of the past.
